cases.sql: SELECT x FROM t UNION SELECT y FROM u INTERSECT SELECT z FROM v
cases.reason: SG29-006 frozen-pin drift, upstream #8704/86abcde3: INTERSECT binds above UNION. Correct scopes are Select(t), Select(u), Select(v), Intersect(u,v), Union(t,intersect), not the a00dc2e5c left-associated Union(t,u) then Intersect. Hand-owned SetPrecedenceCatchupTest and native row controls retain this grouping. Remove only with the coherent SG29-020 oracle refresh; no blanket scope allowance.
